metrics.metric: Rail passenger trips during World Cup operating period

metrics.metric: Peak daily rail passenger trips during reported period
metrics.notes: Reported as 2.6 times typical daily rail ridership and includes Fan Fest activity.

metrics.metric: World Cup special-train round-trip tickets sold
metrics.notes: Ticket sales are not interchangeable with completed passenger trips.

metrics.metric: Passengers departed Foxboro by train within two hours after matches
metrics.notes: The publication reports an aggregate threshold share, not passenger-level timestamps.

metrics.metric: Ridership change during enhanced-service period
metrics.notes: The public release does not define the comparison denominator in sufficient detail for causal attribution.

metrics.calibration_use: Observed matchday rail-demand context and match-to-match scaling
metrics.metric: METRORail riders across the first four matchdays
metrics.notes: Systemwide matchday rail ridership includes ordinary travel and non-stadium event activity.

metrics.metric: Highest reported METRORail matchday ridership
metrics.notes: This is a full-day systemwide rail count, not a venue-only passenger count.

metrics.calibration_use: Sensitivity range for venue egress demand
metrics.metric: Estimated post-match METRO egress surge midpoint
metrics.notes: Source range is 25,000-30,000 riders; 27,500 is its arithmetic midpoint and remains estimated.

metrics.metric: KC Streetcar passenger trips during the tournament period
metrics.notes: The count excludes Streetcar Link bus trips and includes everyday non-event travel.
metrics.source_locator: World Cup Month recap opening paragraph

metrics.metric: Peak KC Streetcar daily passenger trips
metrics.notes: The date included the FIFA Fan Festival and a stadium match; attribution is not separable.

metrics.metric: Average KC Streetcar trips on FIFA Fan Festival days
metrics.notes: The publication does not state the number of days included in this average.

metrics.metric: Maximum streetcars operated during peak festival hours
metrics.notes: The source reports a range of 9-12 streetcars and 6-8 supplemental buses.

metrics.metric: Streetcar Ambassador deployment during the tournament
metrics.notes: Ambassador hours exclude other operations, safety, maintenance, and contracted labor.

metrics.calibration_use: Direct shuttle and feeder-service throughput benchmark
metrics.metric: Direct enhanced-service rides to and from the stadium
metrics.notes: The total covers direct service between the stadium and 15 parking/transit hubs.

metrics.metric: FTA funding coordinated for enhanced World Cup service
metrics.notes: Allocated funding is not the same as audited expenditure.

metrics.metric: Metrorail riders carried to all matches
metrics.notes: The publication does not provide match-by-match or station-time records.

metrics.metric: Game Day Express passengers moved to and from the stadium
metrics.notes: The source describes passengers moved in both directions; the artifact avoids treating the total as unique people.

metrics.metric: Metromover trips during Fan Festival period
metrics.notes: Fan Festival movement is separate from stadium access.

metrics.metric: Event-related passengers moved during eight matches
metrics.notes: The report states over 370,000; the stored value is a lower bound, not an exact count.

metrics.metric: Average peak transportation throughput
metrics.notes: The report presents an average and does not publish interval observations behind it.

metrics.metric: Average New York Penn Station to stadium trip time
metrics.notes: The publication does not state sample size or travel-time dispersion.

metrics.metric: Transportation ambassador shifts staffed
metrics.notes: The report states more than 4,000 shifts and more than 700 ambassadors.

metrics.metric: Average passengers moved out of NRG Station after a match
metrics.notes: The source reports an average and does not publish the averaging sample or time interval.

metrics.metric: Average B Line ridership change on match days
metrics.notes: The comparison baseline is the agency's published match-day comparison, not reconstructed here.

metrics.metric: System ridership change on World Cup match days
metrics.notes: Systemwide change includes ordinary travel and other activity on match days.

metrics.granularity: Match M008 ingress and egress total
metrics.metric: VTA passengers for the opening stadium match
metrics.notes: The source combines travel to and from the match.

metrics.notes: The source states nearly 7,000; the stored value is approximate.

metrics.notes: The source states almost 1,600 trips.
